annotations.annotation_text: Editorial note on the threshold of Book IV. The dream shifts from the enclosed bedroom of Book III to the open morning skies over Dublin Bay. The ensuing text at 593.01 inaugurates the Eastern dawn prayer ('Sandhyas!'), Saint Kevin in his water-trough, Saint Patrick confronting the Druid Balkelly, and ALP's concluding dissolution into the sea.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. University of Wisconsin Press, 1986.
Campbell, Joseph, and Henry Morton Robinson. A Skeleton Key to Finnegans Wake. Harcourt, Brace, 1944.
